recipes.name: Pizza Gyoza inspired by Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
ingredients: 275 g low moisture mozzarella cheese, cubed
1 can (28 oz) San Marzano tomatoes (whole or chopped)
As needed dumpling wrappers, (defrosted if applicable)
As needed low moisture mozzarella cheese
instructions: For the Pizza Gyoza Filling
In the bowl of a food processor, add the pepperoni. Process until paste forms. - 150 g pepperoni cubed

Add the cheese, basil, and oregano. Process the mixture until the ingredients are well combined but there are still a few pieces of visible mozzarella remaining. - 275 g low moisture mozzarella cheese cubed - 3 ½ leaves basil torn - ¼ tsp dried oregano
Reserved until ready to use.
For the Pizza Dipping Sauce
Puree the tomatoes using an immersion blender or food processor. - 1 can (28 oz) San Marzano tomatoes (whole or chopped)
Transfer the tomatoes to a medium saucepot.

Add the basil, oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper to the sauce. - 1 small basil stem (with leaves) - 1 tsp dried oregano - 1 large garlic cloves halved - 1 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
Cook over medium-low heat for 20 minutes.
Once the sauce has cooked, remove the basil and garlic.
Reserve the sauce until ready to use.
For the Pizza Gyoza
Spoon about 2 teaspoons of filling onto the center of one dumpling wrapper. - As needed water - As needed dumpling wrappers (defrosted if applicable)
Using your finger, brush ½ of the circumference of the wrapper with water - As needed water
Fold half of the wrapper over the filling and seal the dumpling with small pleats. - For the Pizza Gyoza Filling
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Begin heating 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat in a large, high-sided (preferably nonstick or carbon steel) pan. - As needed neutral oil
Once the oil has preheated, add the dumplings flat-side down. Pan fry them until the bottoms have become golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Reduce the heat to medium and add ¼ cup of water to the pan. Cover and let the gyoza steam for 6-8 minutes.
Serve immediately with a side of the reserved sauce. Repeat the cooking process with the remaining dumplings.
For the Skirt
Add the cornstarch and flour to a small bowl, whisk to combine. - 2 tsp cornstarch - 1 tsp all purpose flour
Add the water and rice vinegar, once again, whisk to combine. Reserve until ready to use. - ½ cup water - ¼ tsp rice vinegar
For the Pizza Gyoza Pie
Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Begin heating 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat in a large, high-sided (preferably nonstick) pan. - 1 tbsp neutral oil
Once the oil has preheated, add the dumplings flat-side down in a circular pattern. Pan fry them until the bottoms have become golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes. - For the Pizza Gyoza
Add the skirt mixture to the pan, then cover and steam the dumplings for 4-5 minutes. - For the Skirt
Uncover the pan and allow the gyoza to cook for another 6-8 minutes or until the skirt is well browned.
Carefully, flip the skirt-ed gyoza onto an oven-safe plate.
Add sauce, cheese, and pepperoni to the top of the skirt as desired. - As needed low moisture mozzarella cheese - slices As needed pepperoni
Transfer the plate to the oven and bake until the cheese has melted about 5-6 minutes.
Allow the pizza to cool for 5 minutes before serving.
